llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究17-4PH不锈钢的选区激光熔化工艺参数和力学性能，未涉及生物医用植入物、多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能等方向核心内容。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or surface roughness evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化17-4PH不锈钢选区激光熔化工艺参数以获得高密度和良好力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率、扫描速度和扫描间距等参数进行实验，测试密度和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 确定了最优工艺窗口，获得接近全致密的样品和优良的拉伸强度及硬度。
summary_zh.validation: 采用密度测量、金相观察和拉伸/硬度测试验证工艺优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the selective laser melting process parameters for 17-4PH stainless steel to achieve high density and good mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Experimental investigation by varying laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing, followed by density and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Identified optimal process window yielding near-fully dense parts with excellent tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Validation through density measurements, metallographic observation, and tensile/hardness tests.

papers.title: Multilayered drug delivery coatings composed of daidzein-loaded PHBV microspheres embedded in a biodegradable polymer matrix by electrophoretic deposition.
papers.abstract: The development of drug delivery coating systems for local and long-term drug release is gaining increasing interest especially to functionalize bioinert implants with osseointegration and antibacterial properties. In this study, a biodegradable drug delivery coating platform consisting of drug-loaded PHBV microspheres embedded in an alginate-PVA matrix was fabricated by a one-step electrophoretic deposition (EPD) process. Layer by layer (LbL) deposition was exploited to generate chitosan-alginate multilayers on the EPD-produced coating to enlarge the diffusional barrier around the microspheres for controlled drug release. Daidzein, selected as a model drug due to its anti-osteoporosis properties, was pre-encapsulated in PHBV microspheres. The parameters for microsphere fabrication were optimized by an orthogonal design approach. The loading efficiency of daidzein in both the microspheres and in the deposited coatings was adjusted by varying the processing parameters during microsphere fabrication and the EPD process. The degradation of the deposited multilayers was investigated in PBS for up to 14 days. The degradation rate, surface roughness and wettability, as well as adhesion strength of the coatings during degradation were evaluated by applying a range of techniques. A controlled and sustained daidzein release was detected from both free microspheres and microsphere-containing coatings. Finally cytotoxicity and stimulatory effects of daidzein or daidzein-loaded coatings, on both MC3T3-E1 and RAW264.7 cell lines, were studied to validate the potential of the developed coatings for orthopedic applications.

summary_zh.result: 实现了大豆苷元的持续释放，涂层具有可控降解速率和良好细胞相容性
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外降解实验、细胞毒性及刺激实验验证涂层性能

summary_en.motivation: To develop a biodegradable drug delivery coating for local and long-term release to enhance osseointegration and antibacterial properties of bioinert implants.
summary_en.method: A one-step electrophoretic deposition (EPD) process was used to embed daidzein-loaded PHBV microspheres in an alginate-PVA matrix, followed by layer-by-layer deposition of chitosan-alginate multilayers.
summary_en.result: Controlled and sustained daidzein release was achieved, with tunable degradation rate, surface roughness, and adhesion strength, and the coatings showed good cytocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: In vitro degradation studies, cytotoxicity assays on MC3T3-E1 and RAW264.7 cells, and evaluation of surface properties validated the coating performance.
